name: ${NAME}
description: P3B-F streaming F0 v2 fidelity A/B (P3B-B scorer v2, ADR 0009): the voice in ${SLOT} on ${EP}, ${PITCH} F0, ${BLOCK_MS} ms engine blocks on the voice changer's default 512-frame device block, ${EXTRA_MS} ms extra context, ${LOOKAHEAD_MS} ms lookahead, the ${PRESET} preset, levers ${LEVERS_JSON}, the clip ${CLIP} scored at three absolute offsets (leads of at least 4 s, so the stream starts in silence and the silence skip runs before every utterance) against ceiling A (long shape, the primary), ceiling B and the whole-utterance ceiling, with the floors. The fed-F0 rows (fine pitch error, gross pitch error, V/UV and onset lag of the F0 the engine fed its generator, against whole-clip RMVPE of the input) are the P3B-F targets; MCD, speaker cosine and DNSMOS must stay within noise. Materialized by scripts/bench/specs/p3b/f/run_fidelity.ps1, each side with its own SIGIL_VC_F0_* / SIGIL_RMVPE_* switches in its environment (one executable).
